contents.name: §6.4.1 pp. 157-159, (6.30)-(6.36): the point charge density ρ=qδ³(x-r(t)), the current J=qv δ³(x-r(t)), the one-dimensional delta substitution ∫dt' R(t')^{-1}δ(t-f(t')) and the Liénard-Wiechert potentials φ=(q/4πε0)(1/κR), A=(qμ0/4π)(v/κR) at the retarded root

contents.name: §6.4.3 pp. 161-164, (6.39)-(6.45): the retarded derivatives with κ=1-R̂·v/c, the electric field (6.42) E=(q/4πε0)[(R̂-v/c)/(γ²κ³R²)+R̂×((R̂-v/c)×a)/(κ³Rc²)] and the magnetic field (6.44)-(6.45) B=R̂×E/c
